Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with signs or symptoms or risk of cardiovascular disease may participate in this training protocol.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has documented history of recurrent myocardial infarctions, coronary artery disease, diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and family history of sudden cardiac death, all indicating cardiovascular risk.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Coronary artery disease with effort or rest angina or inducible myocardial ischemia as determined by noninvasive testing.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has Stage III coronary artery disease with multivessel involvement and impaired left ventricular function, consistent with ischemia.
No mention of valvular heart disease in patient history.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Cardiomyopathies, including restrictive, congestive, and hypertrophic phenotypes.
Peripheral-artery disease of upper or lower extremities, with intermittent pain with activity (e.g. claudication) or limb-threatening ischemia.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of peripheral-artery disease in patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Renovascular disease with uncontrolled hypertension, intermittent pulmonary edema, or evidence of ischemic nephropathy.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of renovascular disease, hypertension, pulmonary edema, or ischemic nephropathy.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Congenital heart disease, with communications between chambers or major vessels
Heart surgery patients treated at the Clinical Center prior to closure of the Heart Surgery Branch in 1990
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient underwent coronary artery bypass grafting in 2015 (implied age 55 years 6 months), which is after 1990.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Pregnancy, for those patients who require testing or treatment requiring dobutamine, gadolinium or contrast media or radiation exposure.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is male and not pregnant.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Inability of patient, parent or legal guardian to provide informed consent.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient.

Recap: Patient meets multiple inclusion criteria for cardiovascular disease (myocardial infarction, coronary artery disease, cardiomyopathy) and provides informed consent. No exclusion criteria are violated.
